Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring state immunity for certain volunteer claims based on injury or occupational disease.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to volunteer services provided to the state; andamending RCW 51.12.035.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 51.12.035 and 2002 c 175 s 39 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) Volunteers shall be deemed employees and/or workers, as thecase may be, for all purposes relating to medical aid benefits underchapter 51.36 RCW. ((A)) (b) As used in this subsection, "volunteer" ((shall)) meansa person who performs any assigned or authorized duties for the stateor any agency thereof, except emergency services workers as describedby chapter 38.52 RCW, brought about by one's own free choice, receivesno wages, and is registered and accepted as a volunteer by the state orany agency thereof, prior to the occurrence of the injury or thecontraction of an occupational disease, for the purpose of engaging inauthorized volunteer service((: PROVIDED, That such)). The personshall be deemed to be a volunteer although he or she may be grantedmaintenance and reimbursement for actual expenses necessarily incurredin performing his or her assigned or authorized duties. p. 1 HB 2744 (c) Any and all premiums or assessments due under this title onaccount of ((such)) volunteer service covered under this subsectionshall be the obligation of and be paid by the state or any agencythereof which has registered and accepted the services of volunteers. (d) Volunteers who provide volunteer services to the department ofcorrections in an inmate education program or as a chaplain do not haveany right of action whatsoever against the state or the department ofcorrections on account of an injury incurred or an occupational diseasecontracted in the course of that volunteer service, except as otherwiseprovided in this title. (2)(a) Except as provided in RCW 51.12.050, volunteers may bedeemed employees and/or workers, as the case may be, for all purposesrelating to medical aid benefits under chapter 51.36 RCW at the optionof any city, county, town, special district, municipal corporation, orpolitical subdivision of any type, or any private nonprofit charitableorganization, when any such unit of local government or any suchnonprofit organization has given notice of covering all of itsvolunteers to the director prior to the occurrence of the injury orcontraction of an occupational disease. ((A)) (b) As used in this subsection, "volunteer" ((shall)) meansa person who performs any assigned or authorized duties for any((such)) unit of local government((,)) or ((any such)) nonprofitorganization described in (a) of this subsection, except emergencyservices workers as described by chapter 38.52 RCW, or fire fighterscovered by chapter 41.24 RCW, brought about by one's own free choice,receives no wages, and is registered and accepted as a volunteer by anysuch unit of local government((,)) or any such nonprofit organizationwhich has given ((such)) the notice((,)) required in (a) of thissubsection for the purpose of engaging in authorized volunteerservices((: PROVIDED, That such)). The person shall be deemed to bea volunteer although he or she may be granted maintenance andreimbursement for actual expenses necessarily incurred in performinghis or her assigned or authorized duties((: PROVIDED FURTHER, That)).However, juveniles performing community restitution under chapter 13.40RCW may not be granted coverage as volunteers under this section. (c) Any and all premiums or assessments due under this title onaccount of ((such)) volunteer service covered under this subsection forany ((such)) unit of local government((,)) or ((any such)) nonprofit HB 2744 p. 2 organization described in (a) of this subsection shall be theobligation of and be paid by such unit of local government or nonprofitorganization which has registered and accepted the services ofvolunteers and exercised its option to secure the medical aid benefitsunder chapter 51.36 RCW for such volunteers.
